title: Where to threshold and how to compose: a unit-robust cut audit and a t-norm path analysis for log-derived fuzzy prerequisite graphs (code, results and run files)
description: Code, derived graphs, result files and reproduction scripts of the Knowledge-Based Systems manuscript 'Where to threshold and how to compose: a unit-robust cut audit and a t-norm path analysis for log-derived fuzzy prerequisite graphs' (H.B. Truong). This record holds only that manuscript; release 6.0.0 separated it from the shared repository fuzzy-kg-modularity, with no change to any code or result of release 5.4.1. A related manuscript by the same author (Applied Soft Computing, ASOC-D-26-17250, under review; archive 10.5281/zenodo.23074830) uses the same Junyi log, crowd-annotated pairs and adjacent transitions; this archive contains none of its code or data and does not compare graded with majority-vote weights. Release 6.1.0 adds the analyses of the fifteenth review (results/v20). See README.
